integrity: All stated comparisons follow from explicit product Grams and a symbolic case classification; finite rational arithmetic is a reproducibility check rather than proof of universal claims. Scientific independence has not been externally audited.
scientific_limitations: Only two components in dimension two, one full epoch of noiseless exact-arithmetic unit-step SGD with positive-definite Hessians \(I-a uu^{\mathsf T}\) and \(I-b vv^{\mathsf T}\); Euclidean squared error to the common minimizer; no later-epoch or hardware guarantees; priority risk remains.
title: Sharp angular–imbalance frontier for pointwise random-reshuffling risk on two SPD quadratics
